name: FSBM Holdings Berhad
overview: 2026年，FSBM Holdings Berhad 与 Cydentiq Sdn. Bhd. 签署了谅解备忘录协议，涉及创新解决方案的开发与营销合作；同时，与 Exitra Sdn. Bhd. 及 Selangor Human Resource Development Centre 的两份谅解备忘录到期失效，双方同意不再延长。公司与 Nanyang Petal Sdn. Bhd. 关于棕油种植园领域合作的谅解备忘录年内没有实质进展。此外，公司完成了多轮新股发行募资。
overview_en: In 2026, FSBM Holdings Berhad entered into a Memorandum of Agreement with Cydentiq Sdn. Bhd. for the joint collaboration to develop and market innovative solutions. Meanwhile, two Memoranda of Understanding with Exitra Sdn. Bhd. and Selangor Human Resource Development Centre lapsed and the parties mutually agreed not to extend them. The MOU with Nanyang Petal Sdn. Bhd. for collaboration in the palm oil plantation sector saw no material development during the year.

segments.name: 智能应用与数字解决方案
segments.note: 年内与 Cydentiq 签署谅解备忘录协议推进创新解决方案合作，与 Exitra 的谅解备忘录到期失效。
segments.note_en: During the year, entered into a Memorandum of Agreement with Cydentiq for innovative solutions collaboration, while the MOU with Exitra lapsed.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 全资子公司 FSBM I-Design Sdn. Bhd. 于2026年6月18日与 Cydentiq Sdn. Bhd. 签署谅解备忘录协议，探索合作开发与营销创新解决方案。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary FSBM I-Design Sdn. Bhd. entered into a Memorandum of Agreement with Cydentiq Sdn. Bhd. on 18 June 2026 to explore a partnership to develop and market innovative solutions.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: FSBM I-Design Sdn. Bhd. 与 Exitra Sdn. Bhd. 的谅解备忘录于2026年5月26日到期失效，双方同意不延长。
actions.text_en: The MOU between FSBM I-Design Sdn. Bhd. and Exitra Sdn. Bhd. lapsed on 26 May 2026 and the parties mutually agreed not to extend it.

segments.name: 智能制造解决方案
segments.note: 年内与 Selangor Human Resource Development Centre 的研发合作谅解备忘录到期失效。
segments.note_en: During the year, the R&D collaboration MOU with Selangor Human Resource Development Centre lapsed.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 全资子公司 FSBM MES Elite Sdn. Bhd. 与 Selangor Human Resource Development Centre 的谅解备忘录于2026年5月26日到期失效，双方同意不延长。
actions.text_en: The MOU between wholly-owned subsidiary FSBM MES Elite Sdn. Bhd. and Selangor Human Resource Development Centre lapsed on 26 May 2026 and the parties mutually agreed not to extend it.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 年内就棕油种植园领域合作谅解备忘录发布状态更新，并完成多轮新股发行募资。
segments.note_en: During the year, issued status updates on the palm oil plantation sector collaboration MOU and completed several rounds of new share issuance for fund raising.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 全资子公司 FSBM I-Command Sdn. Bhd. 与 Nanyang Petal Sdn. Bhd. 关于棕油种植园领域合作的谅解备忘录自上次2026年5月26日公告以来没有实质进展。
actions.text_en: There has been no material development on the MOU between wholly-owned subsidiary FSBM I-Command Sdn. Bhd. and Nanyang Petal Sdn. Bhd. for collaboration in the palm oil plantation sector since the last announcement dated 26 May 2026.

actions.title: NEW ISSUE OF SECURITIES (CHAPTER 6 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : FUND RAISING
actions.text: 公司进行新股发行募资。
actions.text_en: The company undertook a new issue of securities for fund raising.
